name: Build Your Own Git
description: Implement core Git functionality: init, add, commit, log, branch, checkout, and diff.
readme:
# Build Your Own Git

Implement a simplified version of Git in Rust.

## Stages

1. Init: Initialize a new repository with a .git directory
2. Add & Commit: Stage files and create commits with SHA-1 hashing
3. Log & Status: View commit history and working tree status
4. Branch & Checkout: Create branches and switch between them
5. Diff: Show differences between commits and working tree

## Getting Started

Each stage builds on the previous one. Start with stage 1.
